scope: steps1-3; retrospective feasibility, not best-window selection
leap_day: February29 maps to February28 when anniversary year has no leap day
selection: minimum pooled past-match log loss from2000 through preceding year; exact ties prefer cumulative then longer years
latent_truth: independent centred relative-strength paths; probit and variance-matched logistic observations

pairwise_inference.reason: research and hyperparameters have reused historical data; valid prospective/prespecified conditional assumptions must be checked

pilot.budget_role: operational pilot guard, not a scientific equivalence or optimum criterion

joint_candidate_selection: development-only; maximum6 policies, register before evaluation
failure_policy: preserve error and incomplete outputs; no silent dropping, replacement prior or threshold relaxation; fail stage gate
